en.title: Accessibility Digest: Tech, Tourism, and Sports Highlights for May 22, 2026
en.summary: Day 5 of an online training program covers mental health, multiple sclerosis, and accessibility to build fear-free spaces; accessibility is highlighted as a strategic factor for senior tourism competitiveness in Europe; Konnex World's Web3 project prioritizes interoperability and accessibility for inclusive decentralized tools; Apple Intelligence introduces new accessibility features including enhanced VoiceOver, natural Voice Control, AI-generated captions and Vision Pro wheelchair support; the UEFA Women's Champions League final in Oslo offers sensory rooms, upgraded accessibility, healthy food options and cup recycling to promote inclusion.

highlights.title: Breaking the Silos: Building Fear-Free Spaces for All
Accessibility Drives Senior Tourism Competitiveness in Europe
Web3 Project Emphasizes Accessibility for Inclusive Decentralized Tools
Apple Intelligence adds accessibility upgrades: VoiceOver, Voice Control, AI captions, Vision Pro wheelchair support
UEFA Women's Champions League Final Features Accessible Facilities

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日摘要：科技、觀光與體育亮點（2026年5月22日）
zh-TW.summary: 線上培訓項目第5天涵蓋心理健康、多發性硬化症與無障礙，致力打造無恐懼空間；無障礙被視為歐洲老年旅遊競爭力的戰略因素；Konnex World 的 Web3 項目強調互操作性與無障礙，以實現包容性去中心化工具；Apple Intelligence 推出新無障礙功能，包括更智慧的 VoiceOver、自然的 Voice Control、AI 生成字幕及 Vision Pro 輪椅支持；歐洲女子冠軍聯賽決賽在奧斯陸提供感官室、提升的無障礙設施、健康食品選擇及杯子回收，以促進可持續性與包容性。

highlights.title: 打破孤岛：为所有人构建无恐惧空间
无障碍推动欧洲老年旅游竞争力
Web3 项目强调可访问性以实现包容性去中心化工具
Apple Intelligence 增加无障碍功能：VoiceOver、Voice Control、AI 字幕及 Vision Pro 轮椅支持
欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛提供无障碍设施
